short_description:
Where to buy your first mask in GTA 6: Chuck's Tackle & Shot in Key Lento, just east of (down the road from) Jason's house. Look for the stand with the alligator head on top; the map index lists it under weapons / Ammu-Nation. The first face covering is a neck gaiter (Game8 lists a $35 bandana on the Neckwear shelf): pull it up over your face. To wear it: hold L1 / LB for the loadout, open items and pick the mask; the D-pad changes how it's worn. Most Ammu-Nation stores sell face coverings too, but many are out of reach early on. No story spoilers.

Sources: PC Gamer, PCGamesN, GamesRadar, Game8, Dork.

Every spot is pinned on our interactive map at vicereplay.com (Guides).

short_es.description: Tu primera máscara en GTA 6 se compra en Chuck's Tackle & Shot, en Key Lento, justo al este de la casa de Jason. Busca el puesto con la cabeza de caimán encima. Compra un pañuelo de cuello y súbelo para taparte la cara: mantén L1 / LB, entra en objetos y elígelo. Casi todas las Ammu-Nation venden también, pero muchas no están abiertas al principio. Fuentes: PC Gamer, PCGamesN, GamesRadar, Game8, Dork.
